sources.note: No phonology: the essay is a dialect geography of Kinnaur with 23 glossed words (body parts, numerals etc.) and 5 sentences (plain and honorific) in each of eight varieties including 'Sunnam boli' (e.g. 'tum kaham ja rahe ho?' = Sunnam 'ḍan godeya?' / hon. 'huni godeya ninh?'), remarks on lexical vs sentence-level similarity, and the caste split in Sunnam (upper caste Sunnami, Harijan Thebar-kad). Pronunciation is mentioned only for local variation within Standard Kinnauri (sec. 15). No accent/tone marks in the Devanagari specimens. First-hand specimen data for Sunam not recorded in Glottolog.
